events.title: M12 — A Passing Curiosity at the Locker
flags: Brief curiosity; returns to duties; no photograph or investigation
events.detail:
13:10 PM. Meenakshi staff locker ke paas aayi. Cardigan ka fold kuch alag laga aur pouch shelf par thoda khiska hua tha.

Meenakshi (halke se): “Arre, yeh maine yahan rakha tha kya?”

Usne ek pal cheezein dekhin. Sab kuch wahi maujood tha. “Shayad subah jaldi mein aise hi rakh diya hoga.” Usne cardigan theek se rakha, locker band kiya aur key apne bag mein rakh li.

13:15 PM. Meenakshi apne hospital duties par laut gayi. Kuch hi der mein uska dhyan agle kaam par chala gaya aur locker wali baat uske zehan se nikal gayi.

events.title: The Farmhouse Evening — Four Adults, Shifting Attention
events.subtitle: Farmhouse end/travel not locked
events.detail: EP03 Scene 01 Naveen × Meenakshi ends at 14:15 and is continued in EP04 from 14:15; exact EP04 emotional consequences remain unwritten. The M12 locker thought was fleeting, did not persist after duties resumed, and does not drive her 17:00 mood. Approved earlier: Aditi leads bold banter; Avi and Yash flirt with both women; mutual teasing is one step bolder than EP02 but not fixed pairings. This is a 17:00 start only, not a claim farmhouse plus return fits 17:00–17:45. End time intentionally open.

beats.title: Two women, two men
beats.body: The four leave together; Aditi leads bolder-than-EP02 double-meaning flirting, and Avi/Yash each tease both women. Meenakshi participates rather than just watching.

beats.title: Meenakshi offers the ride
beats.body: She suggests using her own car and drives the group to the farmhouse; teasing continues en route.

beats.title: One-glass challenge
beats.body: Meenakshi first refuses alcohol, then freely agrees to one glass of wine after light group encouragement. Other three drink more moderately. Her one glass is taken at the start, but does not justify driving later.

beats.title: Aditi sets the temperature
beats.body: Aditi confidently flirts with both men and dances first. All three watch and appreciate her look; Avi's interest and the mutual teasing become more openly apparent.

beats.title: Avi–Aditi chemistry
beats.body: Avi joins for a close dance; hand movements, held hands, near faces, and back-to-chest positions remain consensual, with no kissing.

beats.title: Yash joins
beats.body: Aditi, Avi, Yash dance together with friendly close movement and playful responses; Aditi remains an active lead.

beats.title: Meenakshi joins later
beats.body: The group invites her and she chooses to dance. Avi notices the fitted kurta and her peach-rounded hip curve as she crosses the floor; Yash notices her hourglass waist, steps and changes of expression. Their distinct private glances are visual observations, not permission; Aditi also notices the change in the group's attention.

beats.title: Crossed attention
beats.body: Bold double-meaning remarks from all four and shifting attention toward both women. Meenakshi's outward humour and inward surprise/attraction are distinguished; any exact Naveen memory depends on unwritten EP04.

beats.title: Aditi's dress and boundaries
beats.body: Aditi gets styling compliments. A mischievous attempted glance beneath the mini-dress does not reveal anything; this is framed as a private boundary crossing, not as invitation or consensual exposure.

beats.title: Aditi's suggestion
beats.body: She initiates multiple group and pair photographs with smiles, hand-in-hand positions and close poses. Images are private, no publication/posting presumed.

beats.title: Waist-contact trust
beats.body: Avi/Aditi close poses and Yash/Meenakshi photo. Yash explicitly asks before placing his hand at Meenakshi's waist. She allows the photo pose; that permission is limited to it.

beats.title: Avi's jealousy
beats.body: Avi notices Yash getting unusually comfortable with Meenakshi, privately feels jealousy. Aditi detects Avi's shift despite their earlier flirtation.

beats.title: Meenakshi and Yash
beats.body: Their talk remains personal and flirtatious, not converted into generic concern about the locker. Meenakshi's emotional continuity must incorporate the unwritten post-14:15 Naveen scene.

beats.title: Aditi must leave
beats.body: Aditi has another engagement and arranges a separate cab; Avi and Yash request a drop from Meenakshi, and she agrees.

beats.title: Who sits next to Meenakshi?
beats.body: With a sober driver at the wheel, the only rear seat beside Meenakshi becomes contested. Yash takes it before Avi; Avi takes the front passenger seat. Meenakshi and Aditi see the rivalry and laugh, then Aditi leaves.

beats.title: Unspoken looks
beats.body: Avi catches the peach-round silhouette of Meenakshi's hips as she changes seat position; Yash separately notices the gentle hourglass line of her waist and how she adjusts her plum kurta. These are distinct, private adult-admiration metaphors; each man exchanges a teasing glance, and Meenakshi does not know exactly what was noticed.

beats.title: Fitness-flirt challenge
beats.body: A playful abs/fitness conversation becomes a voluntary challenge. Meenakshi explicitly offers limited clothed abdomen contact, individually for Avi and Yash; she assumes the contact stays over clothing.

beats.title: Avi's turn
beats.body: Brief, roughly 30-second clothed abdomen-contact beat; playful conversation, with Meenakshi setting the scope.

beats.title: Yash's unexpected direct contact
beats.body: A shift of Meenakshi's seat posture while retrieving her phone lifts the edge of the plum kurta. Yash's fingers accidentally slip just under the edge toward her abdomen, differing from her assumption of over-clothing contact. She is briefly surprised and tense; he pauses and checks her comfort. She consciously agrees to continued direct abdomen contact for up to about one minute. Her reaction is private and conflicted; do not portray her silence as consent or turn the outline into explicit prose.

beats.title: Quiet aftermath
beats.body: The encounter ends; they adjust posture and say little. No escalation or kiss. The car resumes toward the drop-off.

beats.title: Avi jokingly kicks Yash
beats.body: Both men exit. Avi mock-jealously gives Yash a light, playful kick for the seating/attention rivalry; Yash jokes back. Meenakshi sees them from the car and smiles shyly.

beats.title: Three memories — not home yet
beats.body: Meenakshi continues toward home with the sober driver. Her mind moves among Naveen's unresolved afternoon continuation, Avi's open flirtation/jealousy, Yash's closer personal encounter, and her awareness of the wine. Stop before home arrival.

events.title: The Badminton Bet
events.subtitle: Badminton/travel provisional
flags: Vehicle transfer and court arrival unresolved

beats.title: A familiar court, a different evening
beats.body: Meenakshi reaches the court walkway after the sober-driven return, before entering home. Uday and Utkarsh have finished a short rally and recognize her. Both notice the relaxed evening appearance; the woman they teased at 07:45 is now smiling at them deliberately.
beats.internal: Meenakshi senses their interest without needing a verbal explanation. Morning's attention is familiar, evening's self-awareness stronger.

beats.title: Morning fashion report becomes evening challenge
beats.body: Uday references his morning fashion-report joke and comments on her off-duty look. Utkarsh adds an unexpectedly sharp double meaning. Meenakshi answers with a playful medical/fitness quip and openly notices the men's athletic post-game appearance.
beats.internal: A mild wine glow makes her laugh more easily, but her choices are conscious.

beats.title: She asks to try badminton
beats.body: Meenakshi asks how long the twins have been practicing. They explain their recurring evening routine (new proposal). She requests a racket and initiates a short challenge; no full game in unsuitable clothes.
beats.internal: She likes that she is the one asking to spend another few minutes with them.

beats.title: Uday: intentional waist guidance
beats.body: Uday demonstrates side-on stance and asks if he may guide her position. She agrees. Standing close, he places a hand at her clothed side-waist, with his other hand adjusting her racket arm. He holds the stance for a few deliberate seconds—more personal than incidental brushing. She notices and answers his teasing with a steady smile.
beats.internal: Meenakshi feels a brief flush and slight self-consciousness, then makes a deliberate choice to finish the demonstration. No unasked extra contact.

beats.title: Utkarsh: her invitation changes the balance
beats.body: Utkarsh jokes that Uday's stance is all show and no balance. Meenakshi challenges him to demonstrate. At her invitation he stands near her side and, after she confirms, rests his hand briefly across her clothed side abdomen/core to show the posture difference, then withdraws when the demonstration ends. Contact is deliberate and individually agreed, not a repeat of the car abs game.
beats.internal: She appreciates Utkarsh's unusual confidence; his less obvious flirtation makes her hesitate a moment before her comeback.

beats.title: The two brothers notice the difference
beats.body: Uday mock-complains that Meenakshi gave Utkarsh the longer chance to teach. Utkarsh offers a calm, witty response. Meenakshi deliberately keeps the rivalry playful, instead of explaining her feelings.
beats.internal: The brothers' private motives are distinct: Uday jealous of attention, Utkarsh pleased by her invitation; Meenakshi understands the banter has a personal undercurrent.

events.title: The First Different Look — Babloo
events.subtitle: Babloo first interaction, planning only
events.detail: Two-paragraph established helper history followed by first direct personal encounter at Tower C after badminton; five approved plot beats, with first appreciative glance and teasing compliment, car breakdown connection, and tomorrow's help offer.

beats.title: Unexpected meeting
beats.body: At around 6:45 PM the twins have just dropped Meenakshi after badminton. Babloo is arranging pharmacy parcels near Tower C. He catches the boys’ playful goodbye but is not involved in it.
beats.internal: The reader already knows Babloo as a society pharmacy helper; this is the first proper personal conversation with Meenakshi.

beats.title: First different look
beats.body: Babloo notices Meenakshi's loose hair, plum kurta’s hourglass silhouette, cheerful expression and softer-than-usual smile. His appreciative gaze holds for a moment and Meenakshi notices.
beats.internal: This differs from how he normally sees her at work; no hidden exposure or unwanted physical contact.

beats.title: Flirtation
beats.body: Meenakshi starts with a teasing question. Babloo responds with an unexpectedly confident compliment; she smiles and continues the playful exchange.
beats.internal: First clearly personal compliment; Meenakshi responds knowingly and playfully.

beats.title: Concern beyond appearance
beats.body: Babloo notices that Meenakshi's own car has not returned. She explains the car stopped working near the badminton court. He genuinely offers to help check or recover it tomorrow.
beats.internal: His concern goes beyond her appearance and gives their next interaction a distinct practical purpose.

beats.title: Closing hook
beats.body: Meenakshi agrees to Babloo's help with her car the following day. They part by the lift. She recalls his unusual confidence as she walks away, and Babloo remembers her positive response to his compliment.
beats.internal: EP03 Meenakshi viewpoint ends here; Episode 04 car-recovery scene is a potential next encounter, not already written.
